{{Quote|Jaden.|Lassin, speaking during Jaden Korr's Force vision|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
'''Lassin''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]], who [[Death/Legends|died]] soon after the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] crisis<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> around [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].<ref name="Death date" /> In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', in which Lessin appears as a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] to [[Jaden Korr]], to [[41 ABY]].</ref> Lassin&mdash;along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kam Solusar]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]]&mdash;appeared to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaden Korr]] in a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]]. In the vision, Lassin and the others had [[The Force/Legends|Force]] signatures more like [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] than Jedi, and they told Korr to go to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]]. This led Korr to discover an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] research facility on a [[frozen moon]] where [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] had ordered [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to produce [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] by combining Jedi and Sith [[DNA/Legends|DNA]]. In the facility, Korr encountered a [[Alpha (clone)|clone]] of Kam Solusar, and he believed the other clones may have been produced from the DNA of Lassin and the other people in his vision.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lassin first appeared as a vision in the novel ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
